question.text: A circular plate is rotating in horizontal plane, about an axis passing through its centre and perpendicular to the plate, with an angular velocity <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ω</mi></math>. A person sits at the centre having two dumbbells in his hands. When he stretched out his hands, the moment of inertia of the system becomes triple. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>E</mi></math> be the initial Kinetic energy of the system, then final Kinetic energy will be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>E</mi><mi>x</mi></mfrac></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is

solution.text:
The kinetic energy is given by 

E=12Iω2=L22I

It is given that the new moment of inertia

 I'=3I 

Clearly, the final kinetic energy is

Ef=L22I'=L26I⇒Ef=E3
